cohort: The study included 100 participants, with a primary group of women who underwent cesarean section and a control group of women who had vaginal deliveries.
finding: Women in the cesarean section group were of advanced age, gave birth to smaller infants, and experienced more pre-eclampsia/eclampsia episodes, with the risk of complications following a cesarean section being notably heightened in cases involving multiple cesarean sections, obesity, and smoking.
mod_finding: The risk of complications following a Caesarean section is notably heightened in cases involving multiple cesarean sections.
birth_weight: N/A (though 'smaller infants' were noted in the CS group)
